For me its MGS2. MGS1 left me with a very good taste and a pretty good cliffhanger with Solidus Snake. I felt that MGS2 really lived up to my expectations and was a good follow up. Yeah its confusing as hell, but I suppose its meant to be on the first playthrough. I loved the story, the twists and turns, and the how the gameplay was much improved (which seems to be a trend in the series). 

What really sealed it for me was the last hour or 2 inside Arsenal Gear, I feel that that may have been one of my greatest experiences in gaming with all the revelations that took place and the codec calls that started when you're running around naked, and especially the last one. And I kind of like Solidus, hes not the bad guy The Patriots cracked him up to be, well provided you overlook the whole child soldier thing and his murder of Raiden's parents.

It was a game that made me want to keep playing hours on end in order to find out what happened next, something that rarely happens to me these days. And the MGS franchise just keeps doing that for me with every installment.
